data.one_liner: A Flutter button that scales on tap with customizable bounds and duration
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple button widget that animates its scale when pressed. The scale can be reversed and the animation duration and bound are configurable.
use_when: You need a quick, animated button without custom gesture handling
You want a reusable button that fits any child widget
You prefer a declarative widget over writing custom animation code
avoid_when: You need complex gesture interactions or physics-based motion
You require platform-specific button styles beyond scaling
You are building a large-scale UI library and want to avoid adding extra dependencies
weaknesses: No built-in ripple or elevation effects
No support for long-press or custom gestures
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import 'package:scale_button/scale_button.dart';
